name: Ashfield Land
ownership_summary: Bristol-headquartered private property developer (group parent Ashfield Land Limited, 04363855). Long-standing Blackdog promoter — lodged the 2016 mixed-use application with Kirkwood Homes and says it has 'spent years assembling the land and securing the planning foundations'. Steven McGarva, Managing Director North, is the named spokesman.

name: Ashfield Land (Aberdeen) Ltd
ownership_summary: Active company at the Ashfield Land group registered office (Bristol), incorporated June 2015, SIC 68100. Likely the group vehicle for the Aberdeen/Blackdog landholding, but its role in the data centre venture is inferred from name and group address only.
notes: Inferred candidate SPV — not confirmed as applicant or landowner by primary documents.

name: TechRE
ownership_summary: Described as a data centre specialist/consultancy that has 'delivered projects on behalf of multiple hyperscalers' across UK, Europe, USA and Middle East; partner to Ashfield Land at Blackdog. Companies House shows Edinburgh-registered TECHRE DATA CENTRES LIMITED (SC724371, inc. 2022) and TECHRE CONSULTING LIMITED (SC597436, inc. 2018); which entity is party to the venture is not confirmed. Henry Sutton, Director, is the named spokesman.

name: Kirkwood Homes
ownership_summary: Local housebuilder; co-promoter of the 2016 mixed-use scheme and developer of the consented housing element at Blackdog. No stated role in the data centre.

name: Cerulean Winds
ownership_summary: Floating offshore wind developer (Aspen and two other Central North Sea projects). In discussions with Ashfield over the feasibility of a private-wire link from the Aspen wind farm to Blackdog — discussions only, no contract evidenced. Laura Jarvie, Head of Scotland, quoted in support.
notes: Role best described as prospective power supplier; recorded under technology_partner for lack of a closer enum value.

name: Opportunity North East (ONE)
ownership_summary: Private sector-led regional economic development body; publicly supports the proposal (CEO Jennifer Craw quoted).

name: ETZ Ltd
ownership_summary: Energy Transition Zone Ltd, not-for-profit regional economic development body; publicly supports the proposal (Neil Young, Director of Investment and Development, quoted).

name: Blackdog Land (Aberdeen) Limited
ownership_summary: Aberdeen-registered company (inc. 2013), PSCs Alexander Barclay Thow and Jacqueline Thow (25-50% each). A possibly related land entity given its name and vintage matching the Blackdog Masterplan period; its connection to the data centre consortium is NOT established.
notes: Recorded as a lead only — role as landowner is unverified inference from the company name.
